name: shadcncraft
tagline: Paid shadcn/ui registry plus a 1:1 Figma kit, 8 styles across Radix and Base UI
description: shadcncraft is a commercial shadcn/ui design system shipped as two matched halves: a React registry installed through the shadcn CLI from the `@shadcncraft` namespace, and a suite of Figma kits carrying the same components. Its own catalogue is 192 pro blocks, 55 pro components, 4 hooks, 11 Figma page designs and 1 full site template; the homepage counts of 117 components and 245 blocks include the official shadcn/ui set rebuilt in the Figma kits. Every item is emitted against 8 visual styles crossed with 2 component bases (Radix UI, Base UI) for 16 installable combinations, 24 layerable colour themes and 5 swappable icon libraries. Sold as a one-time purchase per seat by AHO Pty Ltd, with a free tier that installs without credentials.

pricing_detail: One-time, lifetime access, tax included, priced per seat. Base Figma: $119 single / $449 team (5) / $999 enterprise. Pro Figma: $299 / $899 / $1,399. Pro React: $249 / $999 / $1,799. Pro Figma + React: $499 / $1,799 / $2,999. ClearFlow site template $79. Free tier (22 items) needs no licence key. No refunds; upgrades are self-serve and charge only the difference.
agent_guidance: Reach for this when the user already owns a licence and wants pro shadcn blocks installed rather than hand-written — `npx shadcn@latest add @shadcncraft/<name>` drops real shadcn source into their tree, and `npx shadcn@latest list @shadcncraft` / `search @shadcncraft -q "..."` let you discover item names before installing. Pro items 403 without `X-License-Key` and `X-Instance-Name` headers in components.json, so probe with a free item (`@shadcncraft/avatar-stack`) first and fall back to plain shadcn/ui rather than guessing block names. Read https://shadcncraft.com/llms-full.txt before installing: it lists every item slug, tier and install command, which is far cheaper than crawling the site.
why_it_matters: It is the most agent-legible commercial shadcn registry in the index — llms.txt, llms-full.txt, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, a machine-readable pricing.md, shipped agent skills and documented shadcn-MCP compatibility. The Figma-to-React 1:1 layer-name/`data-slot` parity is the genuinely rare part.

name: shadcncraft Free
tagline: 22 shadcncraft registry items that install with the plain shadcn CLI, no licence key
description: The free tier of shadcncraft, reached at free.shadcncraft.com which 308-redirects to shadcncraft.com/free. It exposes 22 registry items served without credentials: 8 blocks (banner-10, benefits-13, contact-11, faqs-4, footer-4, newsletter-signup-5, testimonials-11, top-navigation-5), 11 components (avatar-stack, badge, featured-icon, image-zoom, marquee, page-heading, placeholder-logo, profile-card, section-heading, star-rating, tagline) and 3 hooks (use-carousel, use-click-outside, use-mobile), plus a starter Figma UI kit on Figma Community. Same token structure and style system as the paid kits, just a smaller catalogue — it exists to let you evaluate the system before buying.
pricing_detail: Free, no account or licence key required for these 22 items. Paid tiers start at $119 (Base Figma) and $249 (Pro React).
agent_guidance: Use this as the zero-friction probe before recommending the paid shadcncraft tiers: these 22 slugs install with a bare `npx shadcn@latest add @shadcncraft/<name>` and no headers, so you can prove the registry resolves in the user's project before anyone spends money. Practically it is a marketing-section grab bag (top nav, hero-adjacent benefits, FAQ, footer, newsletter, testimonials) — good enough to finish a landing page, not enough for an app shell. Do not treat it as a separate library from shadcncraft; it is the same registry with a tier flag, so component APIs and tokens carry over exactly.
why_it_matters: A genuinely useful free slice of a paid system — 8 marketing blocks and 11 components that an agent can install with no credentials at all, which is rare among commercial shadcn registries.
notable_for: Installs with the plain shadcn CLI, no licence key
8 blocks + 11 components + 3 hooks, all named in llms.txt

Identical token structure to the Pro kits

name: Kree8 Studio — Mobile Apps
tagline: Mobile app UI portfolio from a productized design studio, 26 unnamed case tiles
description: The mobile-apps section of Kree8 Studio's portfolio: a grid of 26 project tiles showing app UI work, all image-only with no project names, client names or case-study copy exposed in the DOM. Kree8 is a small productized design studio run by Jay and Satya that claims 130+ brands and 50+ founders who raised $200M+, selling a $5,149 one-time landing page package and a $7,199 retainer covering landing pages, logos, mobile and web apps, product design, social graphics and 2D/3D animation. Named testimonials include Roy Lee (Cluely), Harsh (Outreachify), Hunter (Profitable) and Greg V (Numbers). Useful as visual reference for mobile screen craft, not as a source of assets or code.
pricing_detail: Kree8 Landing Page Design: $5,149 one-time, 15-20 days, unlimited revisions, 48-hour update cycles, Figma delivery. Add-ons: development +$2,799, extra page +$800/page, animation +$800 each. Kree8 Retainer Service: $7,199 (monthly retainer, 1 active task) covering all services.
agent_guidance: Treat this as human-eyes-only mood reference for mobile app screens — the tiles are Next.js-hydrated images with no alt text, titles or slugs, so scraping it yields nothing an agent can act on. If a user cites it, ask them which specific screen they mean and reproduce the pattern yourself; do not attempt to fetch or enumerate the projects programmatically. For actual mobile UI you can install, pair with a React Native component source instead.
why_it_matters: A clean, current example of the productized design-studio model with public prices, and a decent mobile UI craft reference — but it is a sales page for a service, not a resource you can build from.

name: Monochrome Studio
tagline: Branding-led design and development studio, six-person team, named client outcomes
description: Monochrome Studio is a small branding, UI/UX and development shop led by creative director Matija Elek, positioned around one unified process rather than separate services. Public case studies carry outcome numbers: U Krugu medical podcast (500k subscribers), SignAvatar AI software ($1M raised), Zakulin honey products (100k products sold) and Kežual clothing store. agent_guidance: Nothing here is installable — this is a services site, so use it only when a user asks for branding-studio reference or wants to see how a small shop frames identity-plus-website as one offer. Note that the site 403s a plain fetcher and only returns HTML to a browser User-Agent, so if you must read it, send a real UA rather than reporting it dead. Its own marketing site is the strongest artefact it has; if the user is admiring 'that scroll-heavy studio look', that is what they mean.
why_it_matters: A tight example of the branding-led studio positioning — outcome numbers rather than deliverable lists — worth keeping as a reference for how a small studio presents itself, not as a design resource.

name: SkillsMP
tagline: Search index of 2M+ SKILL.md agent skills scraped from public GitHub repos
description: SkillsMP is an independent, free aggregator that crawls GitHub for SKILL.md files and indexes them — it claims 2,000,000+ skills across 12 top-level domains and 50+ categories, browsable by category, by SOC occupation, or by creator, in 9 languages. It is not a hosting or install platform: every result links back to its source GitHub tree, and installation is the normal Claude Code path (`/plugin add <github-url>` or copying the folder into ~/.claude/skills/). Its real value to an agent is the machine surface: an unauthenticated REST search endpoint, a streamable-HTTP MCP server, an OpenAPI spec and .well-known discovery documents. Not affiliated with Anthropic.
install: npx -y mcp-remote https://skillsmp.com/mcp  # or add {"skillsmp":{"type":"streamable-http","url":"https://skillsmp.com/mcp"}} to mcpServers
pricing_detail: Completely free, no paid tiers. Anonymous API: 50 requests/day, 10/min. With a free API key (Authorization: Bearer sk_live_...): 500 requests/day, 30/min.
agent_guidance: Hit the API directly rather than the web UI — `GET https://skillsmp.com/api/v1/skills/search?q=<term>&limit=20&sortBy=stars` works with no auth and returns name, author, description and the source githubUrl, which is everything you need to go read the actual SKILL.md. Reach for it when a user asks 'is there already a skill for X' before you write one from scratch; pair it with the raw GitHub file since SkillsMP itself hosts no skill content. Watch out: the `stars` field is repo-level and returns implausibly large values, so do not rank quality by it, and 2M+ indexed files means most hits are forks, translations and duplicates — always open the source repo before recommending anything.
why_it_matters: The only broad, freely queryable index of the SKILL.md ecosystem, and one of the few directories in this catalog that ships an MCP server plus an unauthenticated REST endpoint — an agent can actually use it mid-task.
notable_for: Unauthenticated REST search at /api/v1/skills/search
Streamable-HTTP MCP server at https://skillsmp.com/mcp (search_skills, get_skill, list_categories)

name: React Native Components
tagline: 64 copy-paste React Native screen components, $59.99 once for lifetime access
description: A paid, copy-paste library of 64 animated React Native / Expo components (61 currently live) organised into 18 categories: Login, Paywall, Settings, Profiles, Menu, Tabs, Bottom Navigations, Selections, Calendars, Charts & Rings, Walkthrough, Survey Form, Screen Views, Texts, Modals-Sheets, Pull to refresh, Audio Recorder and Essentials. Most items are whole screens or interaction pieces rather than atoms — Claude login, ChatGPT paywall, Airbnb tabs, Discord tabs, Coinbase pull-to-refresh, Apple Fitness tracker, GPT voice recording — and several openly reproduce a named app's UI. There is no CLI or registry: you sign in, read the code and paste it. One base template is included. Built by a single author ('eren'), related to landingcomponents.com; the site also carries side directories for RN packages, app screenshots, articles, tools and jobs.

templates.name: Base template (included with purchase)
templates.purpose: One starter React Native app template bundled with the $59.99 lifetime purchase; two catalogue items also carry downloadable project files.

pricing_detail: $59.99 one-time for lifetime access to all current and future components, plus the newsletter, tools and one base template. Not a subscription. No refunds. Team use is permitted on a single purchase. 10 of the 64 components are marked free. Using the components to train AI output as a company requires a separate commercial licence by arrangement.
agent_guidance: Reach for this only when the user already owns it — the catalogue renders entirely client-side from Supabase behind an auth dialog, so you cannot read component source by fetching a URL and you should never claim to have. It is screen-level, not atom-level: the win is a finished animated paywall, walkthrough or tab bar for an Expo app, which is exactly the layer shadcn-style web registries do not cover. Two cautions — several components are explicit clones of Claude, ChatGPT, Discord, Airbnb and Coinbase UI, which is a trademark risk in a shipped product, and the FAQ says company use of these components to train AI output needs a separate licence, so do not feed them into a fine-tuning pipeline.
why_it_matters: React Native has very little in the way of polished, animation-first screen kits, and this is one of the few that is current, categorised and cheap — it fills the mobile gap that the shadcn ecosystem leaves open.
